notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ v2.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
TYRONE SOULZ v2.0.0 is here, just in time for the tail-end of Black History Month!

Bug Fixes

Fixed bug with reload being cancelled when damaged.
Made Tyrone's skin darker.
Misc bug fixes I can't remember.

New Content

Two new achievements added.
ULTRA INSTINCT Tyrone boss fight added - defeat Tyrone normally to access it. It costs nothing. Totally free. ːTyroneSmugː
Bitch Ass Pussy Mode added - an easy mode for "people" who can't defeat Tyrone normally. It costs a dollar. Pay up. ːAngryCuckoldː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2796840/TYRONE_SOULZ_Bitch_Ass_Pussy_Mode/

notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
* Landmines damage increased, but no knockdown anymore.
* New toggle option in config menu (F2) to disable energy drink. For achievementchads only.
* "Laser attack" improved, damage lines up with visuals now (prior version had a 0.05 sec desync between damage and visuals).

notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes: * Fix some achievements that were not properly triggering (Dehydrated, What A Melon)

notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
* Two new achievements you can actually get
* Global cop death tracker added
* Pressing F1 key now instantly restarts instead of needing to hold it
* Super small nerf to Tyrone HP regen in later phase

notes.title: TYRONE SOULZ v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed bug with energy drink and instakill attack animation
Fixed bug with instakill attack activating during final phase animation
Disabled damage display when Tyrone goes immoral mode
Improved controls display
Fixed bug of Tyrone being stuck in immortal mode when being healed during final phase transition
